name: FlashAttention: Fast and Memory-Efficient Exact Attention with IO-Awareness
publisher: arXiv (Dao, Fu, Wolf, Rudenstein, Smith; NeurIPS 2022)
notes: Tiling attention so Q/K/V tiles are loaded to SRAM once and reused, cutting HBM reads/writes. Claims IO complexity lower than standard attention and optimal for a range of SRAM sizes. Reports 15% end-to-end wall-clock speedup on BERT-large.
